title: {Syn} Chain-of-Thought Prompting Exposed Reasoning Traces
content:
Chain-of-thought prompting showed that asking large language models to produce intermediate reasoning steps can improve performance on multi-step tasks.

The technique also raised evaluation questions, because a fluent explanation is not automatically a faithful explanation of the model internal process.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
